'''Roen''', also known as '''Firefather''' in the [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothite]] [[Language/Legends|language]], was a major [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. It was the site of the only major [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] found on Goroth Prime.
